tickets.title: Exploration at share 1 explores every visitor (**amendment 13, E32, 2026-10-30**)

authority.locator: E32 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (the analysis _evidence/parity-step3/S55/analyst-intermittents/DESIGN.md §4, adopted R-P707; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: at an exploration share of 1 every visitor explores; at every share below 1 the decision is identical to today's; a decision recorded before the fix replays under its recorded rules unchanged, decisions after it stating a new rules marker; P04's N1/N2 CONTROL, and P10's and P15's exploration controls where their share is below 1, draw a pinned visitor at a pinned hour.

tickets.outcome: An exploration share of 1 means every visitor explores. Today explorationPick rounds the visitor's bucket to three decimals and refuses on bucket >= share, so the 0.047% of visitors whose bucket rounds to 1.000 never explore at share 1; the exploration controls that drew a random visitor failed the gate when one of them was drawn.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, at an exploration share of 1, every visitor explores, including a visitor whose raw bucket is at least 0.9995 (which src/learn/explore.ts:219 rounds to 1.000 and :237 refuses today: REPRODUCED 94 of 200,000, _evidence/parity-step3/S55/analyst-intermittents/DESIGN.md §4).
criteria.proof: The P108 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P108.XB1 in src/units/P108/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, at every exploration share below 1, the decision for each visitor and hour of a fixed corpus (boundary buckets included) equals today's, recorded as a fingerprint at the specification's base; and a decision recorded before the fix replays under its recorded rules (historicalRules) unchanged. Decisions made under the fixed rule state a new exploration-rules marker (recorded-draws-v2, beside the page manifest as EXPLORATION_RULES is today); a decision stating recorded-draws-v1 replays under v1's share-1 refusal, and one stating no marker under HISTORICAL_EXPLORATION_RULES, each exactly as recorded (R-P708).
criteria.proof: The P108 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P108.XB2 and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: P04's N1/N2 CONTROL (src/units/P04/LEDGER.unit.test.ts:198) draws a pinned visitor at a pinned hour through the product's own seam (MintTarget.accept or an injected subject at a fixed Date), as do P10's (:367) and P15's (:434, :456) exploration controls where their share is below 1, with every expectation unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P108 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P108.XB3 (which read the controls' pinned subjects) and src/units/P04, P10 and P15 pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: On the acceptance pair's next release, an operator setting an exploration share of 1 on a slot sees every visitor's decision explore on both shopper hosts (read through the decisions API, never pages).

existingEvidence.description: REPRODUCED without load: 94 of 200,000 random visitors do not explore at share 1 (src/learn/explore.ts:219 rounds the bucket, :237 refuses on bucket >= share); a pinned boundary visitor (raw 0.99962 session, 0.99974 do) fails P04.N2's CONTROL on both hosts, an interior one passes. The gate failure S54/gate-r1 (P04.N2, do host) was this, not load (R-P700 corrected by R-P707).

remainingWork: At share 1 every visitor explores, the boundary visitor included; closed by unit:P108.XB1.
At every share below 1 the exploration decision equals today's on a fixed corpus of visitors and hours, and a recorded decision replays under its recorded rules unchanged; closed by unit:P108.XB2.
P04's N1/N2 CONTROL, and P10's and P15's exploration controls where their share is below 1, draw a pinned visitor at a pinned hour; closed by unit:P108.XB3.

decisions.authorityRef: Amendment 13 section 2 E32; R-P707 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md): the minimal fix — share 1 always explores — is chosen over comparing the unrounded bucket, because the latter changes decisions at every share's rounding boundary and the replay of recorded decisions; under the owner's direction of 28 October, R-P545
decisions.effect: Only share 1 changes; every share below 1 is identical to today's, and recorded decisions replay unchanged. Replay fidelity: the rules marker moves to recorded-draws-v2 for decisions under the fixed rule, and recorded-draws-v1 keeps its share-1 refusal on replay (R-P708).

tickets.title: The gate counts, never times (**amendment 13, E33, 2026-10-30**)

authority.locator: E33 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (the analysis _evidence/parity-step3/S55/analyst-intermittents/DESIGN.md §1–§3, §5, adopted R-P707; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: the named tests that failed gates on the shared box's load assert counts, waves, pinned subjects and per-action order instead of wall-clock bounds or one scheduling order; the time stays printed as evidence; each counted form still turns RED on the defect the timed form caught.

tickets.outcome: A whole-suite gate fails only on the product. W12.02, P35.Z2, P102.CR1–CR3 and P105.AL6 failed gates because the shared box was busy (a 10 s observation deadline, a concurrent write order, wall-clock medians, a 250 ms margin), each failure costing a 1–2 hour re-run.

criteria.observable: src/index.api-boundary.test.ts W12.02 (stageMs :1334; src/ops/synthetic.ts stage :509-513, :623-628) waits on the delivery event it records, then makes one re-observation; no wall-clock deadline decides the assertion; every expectation unchanged; the test still fails when delivery does not happen.
criteria.proof: The P109 acceptance command runs src/index.api-boundary.test.ts and the tests named unit:P109.GD1, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: src/units/P35/LEDGER.unit.test.ts P35.Z2 compares the ODP writes action by action, order-free within one action; a leaked second identifier still turns it RED; a delayed event write no longer does.
criteria.proof: The P109 acceptance command runs src/units/P35 and unit:P109.GD2, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: src/units/P102/LEDGER.unit.test.ts CR1 :419, CR2 :476 and CR3 :634 print their wall-clock medians as evidence and assert none; the waves and reads they already check pin the clause, and reading the head and the copy one after the other still turns them RED.
criteria.proof: The P109 acceptance command runs src/units/P102 and unit:P109.GD3, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: src/units/P105/LEDGER.unit.test.ts AL6 (:1678-1680 at P105's head) compares the waves of remote calls that ended before each answer with the no-audience action's instead of a 250 ms margin; with the count awaited on the path it is RED.
criteria.proof: The P109 acceptance command runs src/units/P105 and unit:P109.GD4, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

existingEvidence.description: W12.02: the native observation stage's 10 s deadline races the real queue delivery (src/ops/synthetic.ts :509-513, :623-628). P35.Z2: two concurrent ODP writes in one request (realtime.ts:491/:501, ShopperReflex.ts:1681/:1762), both orders observed; the per-action comparison stays RED on a leaked identifier. P102.CR3 :634 (and CR1 :419, CR2 :476): wall-clock medians, the waves at :632 already pin the clause; a serial read turns the waves RED [2,2,2]. P105.AL6: waves before each answer GREEN 3/3, 5/5 at P105's head, RED 5 against 3 with the count awaited on the path.

remainingWork: W12.02 waits on the recorded delivery event, then makes one re-observation, with no deadline in the assertion; closed by unit:P109.GD1.
P35.Z2 compares the ODP writes action by action, order-free within one action; closed by unit:P109.GD2.
P102.CR1, CR2 and CR3 keep their wall-clock medians as printed evidence only; their waves and reads pin the clause; closed by unit:P109.GD3.
P105.AL6 compares the waves of remote calls ended before each answer instead of a 250 ms margin, once P105 is on rem/integration; closed by unit:P109.GD4.

decisions.authorityRef: Amendment 13 section 2 E33; R-P695 (4), R-P698 (2), R-P706, R-P707 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md); the box law: no manufactured load, so the proofs are deterministic variants, never load; under the owner's direction of 28 October, R-P545
